label: Quest

clips.title: The story
paras: After Brutal Politics, Warug in Magram Village wants proof that you can kill Kolkar the way the Magram do. Head north and slay Kolkar centaurs, scouts and maulers.

Warug sneers that the Kolkar believe themselves strong while the Magram laugh at them as they kill them. Warug wants you to prove you can kill Kolkar as the Magram do, so you head north: twelve Kolkar centaurs, twelve scouts and six maulers are to fall.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The Kolkar think they are strong, but we laugh at them! We laugh and we kill them! You kill them too. Show me you can kill Kolkar like we do. Head north and slay them all!

clips.title: Progress
paras: Are you afraid of the Kolkar? Why do you not kill them? Maybe you forgot how to kill. Hurry and kill Kolkar before they are dead!

clips.title: Completion
paras: The Kolkar fear you now! I hope you laughed when you killed them. It is better to laugh when you kill, so the enemy can see he is weak.
